notes: Two taḥwīl-linked branches: Musa then Hammad; and Hannad through Abu al-Ahwas and Ata' to al-Aghar Abu Muslim and Abu Hurayra.

After Ata' the text splits the last name: «قال موسى عن سلمان الأغر» (Musa's wording, written as a variant group) and «وقال هناد عن الأغر أبي مسلم». The text writes «عن أبي هريرة» once; it is written in both the main and the variant group. Editor glosses (- يعني ابن السري -, - المعنى -, - قال هناد -) are left out.
